<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    Ns=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='N']
    playerN=max(Ns,key=lambda n:n['pixels']); plugN=min(Ns,key=lambda n:n['pixels'])
    pg=min(p[1] for p in playerN['boundary']); pl=min(p[1] for p in plugN['boundary'])
    asc=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def le(r):
        c=0
        while c<64 and asc[r][c]!='G': c+=1
        return c
    return pg,pl,le(10),le(30),le(55)
print("start",state())
for i in range(5):
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':1}])
    print(i+1,"score",res['score'],"done",res['done'],"lvlcomp",res['level_completed'],"->",state())
    if res['done'] or res['level_completed']: break
